conditions: Hall discharge supply OFF and electrically disconnected from the H-1 anode

P1Q-10.definition_recorder_reading: I_e,cap = I_e,collector,RFON - I_e,collector,RFOFF, subject to current-path closure and the registered uncertainty treatment. The verbatim formula lacks 'I_e,cap =' and the minus sign; this reading follows the owner's 'matched RF-OFF measurements used to quantify facility/background electron current' and the verified P1 reducer (I_e_icp_corrected = I_e,RF-on - I_e,RF-off). Owner may correct.
P1Q-10.qualification: I_e,cap >= I_d,max,H1 with the preregistered one-sided lower confidence bound on M_n = I_e,cap/I_d,max,H1 - 1 remaining above zero
P1Q-10.hall_on: Hall-ON measurements are retained only as NEUTRALIZATION_CONSISTENCY, never ICP45_CAPACITY (with Hall ON, I_e,ICP ~ I_d because the anode closes the discharge circuit)
P1Q-10.hall_on_follow_up: after discharge-OFF capacity is shown, repeat the corresponding Hall-ON point and verify sustainment, current closure, neutralization behaviour, stability, collector/reference potentials, RF power

P1Q-13.anode: physically disconnected from the discharge supply and left floating during ICP-45 discharge-OFF capacity measurements (never a commanded-zero supply left attached); V_anode recorded on a high-impedance isolated channel; anode terminal classified OPEN_CIRCUIT_BY_CONSTRUCTION
P1Q-13.body: H-1 body/magnetic circuit has exactly one deliberate facility-ground connection through an instrumented/metered return (ground-current monitor); no second chassis/stand/coax/shield grounding path; I_body->ground measured continuously during capacity measurements
P1Q-13.closure: Kirchhoff residual per ICP-45 point, e.g. I_collector + I_body + I_anode + I_facility + I_ICP,body ~ 0 under the registered sign convention; a large unexplained residual invalidates that capacity point
P1Q-13.measurand: only the dedicated electron-collector current is the capacity measurand; current into H-1 body, facility ground, chamber, floating anode or unintended cable shields does not count
P1Q-13.diagnostic_variant: a metered-return anode configuration may later be run as a separately registered diagnostic; it never replaces the floating-anode baseline because it gives a larger current

P1Q-14.class: the 350 V operating isolation class (row 81) is extended to the ICP body/collector circuits relative to the Hall anode, H-1 body/common, facility ground and other isolated circuits where those potential differences can physically occur (deliberate A9 extension)
P1Q-14.design_margin: V_operating,max = 350 V; V_design,withstand >= 525 V (1.5x; minimum design basis, not the test voltage)
P1Q-14.initial_dwv: passive insulation paths and feedthrough assemblies: 1.05 kV DC for 60 s where component ratings permit; current-limited, sensitive electronics disconnected where necessary, leakage recorded, relevant insulation configuration, before first HV/RF operation; plus representative-pressure/gas testing for Paschen-risk paths
P1Q-14.no_repeated_hipot: the 1.05 kV test is qualification-style, not repeated before each campaign; later acceptance/reverification at an appropriately lower controlled level/procedure unless a fault or hardware modification requires requalification
P1Q-14.rf_insulation: does not close ICP-44: antenna/matching network still need separate qualification for RF peak voltage, RF current, RF creepage/clearance, combined RF + DC stress, vacuum/gas breakdown

P2Q-05.powered_unlit_rule: a COLD_ANTENNA_POWERED_UNLIT record is valid only when the optical channel demonstrates the plasma did not ignite
P2Q-05.threshold: established from dark/background, RF-powered known-unlit and known-lit P1 plasma measurements; frozen before the P2 map; no arbitrary voltage threshold assigned now
P2Q-05.corroboration: record simultaneously photodiode intensity, reflected RF power, antenna current, collector/current-path response, pressure; optical UNLIT with electrical evidence of ignition/mode transition -> UNCERTAIN; lost line-of-sight or saturation -> record not automatically valid
P2Q-05.procurement: photodiode, optical access/window, amplifier and DAQ channel added to the P1_NEEDED / P2 preparation instrumentation quote
